bias.en: Uptrend · pulled back under the 5-day, $388 held
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 回落至 5 日均线下方，$388 守住

read.en: Tesla eased 0.9% on Oct 30 to $399.81, trading between $387.52 and $404.19. It is just under the rising 5-day ($401.3) and above the rising 10-day ($388.1) and 30-day ($376.3) and the falling 200-day ($385.3) and 100-day ($367.9). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 26 and above zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 21 ($369.67), and RSI is 61.
read.zh: 特斯拉 10月30日小跌 0.9%，收于 $399.81，盘中区间 $387.52–404.19。股价略低于上行的 5 日均线（$401.3），位于上行的 10 日（$388.1）和 30 日均线（$376.3）以及下行的 200 日（$385.3）和 100 日均线（$367.9）上方。MACD 自 10月26日起位于信号线上方且在零轴之上，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月21日起看多（$369.67），RSI 为 61。

read.en: The dip to $387.5 undercut the $395.3–397.3 support and tested the $388 cap before the close recovered above it; no written level broke. Resistance is $401.3–404.2 (5-day, Oct 30 high), then $409.3–410.9 (Apr 17 and Oct 28 highs) and $416.4–420.3. Support is $395.3–397.3, then $385.3–388.1 ($388 cap, 10 and 200-day) and $376.3–377.6. A close above $411 would target $416–420; below $395, $388.

s.en: $388 cap since March; 10 and 200-day averages ($385.3–388.1); Oct 30 low $387.5
